Package org.apache.juneau.terminal.report

Class TerminalViewChecks

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.terminal.report.TerminalViewChecks
public final class TerminalViewChecks extends Object
Shared validation grammar; not intended for application use.

The terminal-view grammars live in one place so the server types, the report readers and the client module (which mirrors them, pinned by a shared vectors file) cannot drift.

    • isNoteHref

      public static boolean isNoteHref(String s)
      Whether the string is a safe note href.

      Either an absolute URL whose scheme is exactly http or https and which has a non-empty host, or anything that isSafeLineHref(String) accepts. TAB, CR and LF are stripped first.

      Parameters:
      s - The candidate. May be null.
      Returns:
      true if safe.

    • isRawHrefTemplate

      public static boolean isRawHrefTemplate(String s)
      Whether the string is a valid raw-href template.

      It must contain exactly one {offset} placeholder and, with 1 substituted, be a safe line href.

      Parameters:
      s - The candidate. May be null.
      Returns:
      true if valid.

    • isSafeLineHref

      public static boolean isSafeLineHref(String s)
      Whether a line href is safe: a bare fragment, or a same-origin path accepted by isSameOriginPath(String).

      TAB, CR and LF are stripped first. A backslash anywhere refuses the href.

      Parameters:
      s - The candidate href. May be null.
      Returns:
      true if the href is safe.
